summary:
## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.  
Keep commits small so review stays easy.  
Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.  
Run “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” in between other work; execute its eight steps in order, one at a time.  
The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace: `payments`; canary image: `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3` (`rc.2` superseded); migration job: `api-2-8-0-schema`; integration pool: `ci-runner-arm64`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware; caused duplicate staging invoices.

## Recent work
Rollout steps 1–6 succeeded. Worker fixes passed 118 tests, 7 skipped; memory remained bounded. Consolidated duplicated CLI billing filters, restored `dest="currency"`, updated the obsolete command-layer assertion, and removed the duplicate `--currency/-c` entry. Relevant future test output must be pasted exactly, not paraphrased.
